title: Uncovering Delays: Leveraging Data Science and AI to Streamline Refugee Status Determination Procedures
summary: UNHCR is developing process analysis to identify refugee-status bottlenecks, with pilots planned and no achieved time saving reported.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: The project uses data science and AI to examine refugee-status determination procedures. Its intended benefits include faster administration and earlier access to rights and services. Pilot deployments are expected in a later phase. No processing-time reduction or individual legal-status outcome is yet documented.
purpose: Identify and reduce bottlenecks in refugee-status determination.
system: Uncovering Delays: Leveraging Data Science and AI to Streamline Refugee Status Determination Procedures

ratings.reason: UNHCR bottleneck analysis is in development and pilots are expected next; no achieved processing-time reduction is reported.
Earlier legal recognition and service access are intended effects. Completed outcomes remain undocumented.
Reduced poverty and greater inclusion are anticipated effects of faster recognition.

ai_role.statement: The account does not isolate AI’s contribution from the surrounding workflow.

evidence.citation: International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025). Project-submitted account, current as of June 2025. ITU provides no independent outcome evaluation.
evidence.title: Use Case 8: Uncovering Delays: Leveraging Data Science and AI to Streamline Refugee Status Determination Procedures

produced_by: The account does not establish conditions sufficient to reproduce the benefit.
must_hold: The account does not establish requirements for reproducing the benefit in other settings.

headline: UNHCR studies AI support for refugee-status processing
claim_basis: Sources: the makers' report. The cited evidence includes no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
